languages.selection: Server-side query lang, then explicit English path, then scoped pwa_lang cookie. Language links preserve the corresponding page and catalog filters.
languages.content: Single JSON-valued setting per bilingual editorial text; domain tables have explicit English columns. Inline t:key overrides are merged from text_key_lang settings on every render.

design.structure: 1160px open-book layout, two equal panels, central rule, yellow navigation tabs, mobile single column
deviations: Blue primary actions retain the explicit platform branding requirement; yellow remains the carnet navigation color.
The proposed services/about photographs were inspected and are graphic title panels. The verified portrait is used instead.
No invented clinic photograph or unverified historical price graphic is published.

pages.job: Introduce the personal practice and direct visitors to services and appointments
Browse, search and filter the verified service categories and owner-validated rates
Explain the name and Karin-Alexys’s professional approach
Find verified business contact details and hours
Request an appointment and retrieve private status
Review confirmed billing details and pay through PayPal

tables.seeding: Four verified service-category records, seven imported hour rows and four unpublished draft articles. No fabricated customer, appointment, payment or subscriber records. A seed marker prevents reseeding edited content.

appointments.auth: Platform OTP and biometrics; requireAuth on customer APIs, optionalAuth on pages; no custom auth endpoints
appointments.flow: Authenticated request, validation, PostgreSQL save, optional owner email, private retrieval, owner confirmation and cancellation request
appointments.availability: Visitors submit preferences, not availability claims. Owner confirmation requires exact timezone-aware start/end and a service. A PostgreSQL range exclusion prevents overlapping confirmed appointments for the single practitioner.
appointments.privacy: No health fields. Consent and notice snapshot are stored. New requests remain closed until the owner approves the notice and enables requests.
appointments.email: Recipient only services.config.contactEmail; replyTo is the validated submitter email. Save occurs first. Delivery state is visible to the owner.

payments.provider: PayPal Orders v2, Payments v2 and official JavaScript SDK v6
payments.flow: Owner confirms appointment and billing, customer accepts preserved terms, server creates an idempotent order, official button obtains approval, server validates and captures, server retrieves order and capture details before recording payment
checks: Fixed CAD amount from database, never browser
Capture currency, gross amount and final_capture
payments.recovery: Stable create and capture request IDs, retained order IDs, customer and admin reconciliation, five-minute GET-only background reconciliation. Old unresolved creation attempts stop for manual review instead of risking a new order.
payments.webhooks: Not used. No unsigned webhook endpoint exists.
payments.oauth: Actual server-to-server client_credentials token exchange; no social login or owner OAuth redirect flow.
payments.refunds: Owner initiates refunds in PayPal Business. The app reads provider refund status during reconciliation; appointment cancellation never claims a refund.
payments.callbackUrls: No callback or webhook registration is required for the popup/auto SDK session flow.
payments.setupBoundary: Credentials present does not mean live verification succeeded. Real operations are off by default and preview flags suppress sending and charging.

admin.security: Every admin page and API checks services.admin.isAdmin. JSON writes require same-origin requests and an explicit request header. Financial records cannot be deleted or manually marked paid.

pwa.push: After a meaningful interaction, wait eight seconds and check notifications.enabled before TenantSDK.ui.showPushPrompt; footer also provides data-push-btn
pwa.offline: Platform service worker. Private page HTML contains only shells; private API responses use no-store. No payment success is inferred offline.

directions.implementation: External Google Maps search link constructed only from the validated stored business address
directions.apiKeys: None; no embedded or out-of-scope Google API is called.

contactVerification.result: The source contact page continues to display the business telephone and the Denis Street address. This is source-page verification, not postal or operational verification. ([massotherapiesensoreel.com](https://massotherapiesensoreel.com/contact/))
contactVerification.publicationRule: Application contact settings are seeded only from services.config business fields, not account-owner literals. Publication is gated until the owner confirms that they belong to the practice.

assets.hosting: All reused asset URLs are the supplied R2 copies, never the old host.

Notice, cancellation policy and payment terms require owner approval
